title: Solarpunk
content: Apply solarpunk aesthetic with optimistic eco-futurism. Lush greens integrated with technology. Solar panels and renewable energy motifs. Organic architecture blending with nature. Bright, hopeful color palette: greens, sky blue, solar gold. Include vertical gardens and living buildings. Community and sustainability themes. Art Nouveau meets sustainable tech. Hopeful, green, utopian atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create eco-futuristic solarpunk aesthetic with green technology, organic architecture, and optimistic sustainability.
variants.detailed: Apply solarpunk aesthetic with optimistic eco-futurism. Lush greens integrated with technology. Solar panels and renewable energy motifs. Organic architecture blending with nature. variants.advanced: Apply solarpunk aesthetic with optimistic sustainable futurism. Color palette: lush greens (#2e8b57, #228b22), sky blue (#87ceeb), solar gold (#ffd700), terracotta (#e07040), cream - nature colors dominating tech. Green technology: solar panels integrated beautifully (not industrial), wind turbines, green energy visualizations. Living architecture: buildings with plants growing on/through them, vertical gardens, green roofs, organic curves merged with structures. Nature-tech fusion: vines intertwining with tech elements, bioluminescent lighting, biomimicry patterns. Materials suggested: sustainable wood, recycled materials, natural fiber. Community elements: shared spaces, collaborative imagery, diverse people. Transportation: bikes, trains, electric vehicles, walkable cities. Flora: abundant plants, urban farming, food forests, native species. Patterns: leaf veins, solar cell grids, honeycomb (biomimicry). Typography: friendly, approachable fonts, organic curves. Art Nouveau influence: flowing lines but with tech integration. Illustration: optimistic future scenes, people in harmony with nature/tech. Light: abundant natural light, golden hour optimism, dappled forest light. Interactive: growth animations, blooming effects, energy flow visualization. Sound: nature sounds suggested, birds, water. Implementation: CSS gradients for natural light, SVG for organic shapes. Accessibility: high contrast from natural palette, inclusive imagery important to aesthetic.
